reason: Historical plan retained for provenance only. Under rules 1.4, subject-matter logic defines content capacity; DataForSEO cross-checks and may deduplicate but raw depth rows neither create nor delete article intents.

followup.cluster_selection: Only predefined leaf/topic candidates whose current confirmed distinct depth is below the role threshold and that still contain pending exact-seed evidence.

postprocess: Run keyword_ideas inside each already defined leaf/topic cluster.
Deduplicate candidate depth by core_keyword, otherwise normalized keyword.
Retain at most 15 distinct groups per cluster because 15 already reaches SPLIT_REVIEW.
Run one final bundled keyword_overview over retained evidence keywords.
Merge prior exact evidence with depth evidence and deduplicate again.
Never create, rename, move or delete WordPress/HivePress structure.

historical_outcome.lesson: Raw keyword_ideas rows are not article intents and automatic depth research is not required for normal content-capacity counting.
